;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2019 Villa Unión shootout]]
**A [[shootout]] between [[Federal Police (Mexico)|police officers]] and [[Drug cartel#Mexico|cartel]] gunmen in [[Villa Unión, Coahuila|Villa Unión]], [[Coahuila]], [[Mexico]], leaves at least 21 people dead. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-violence/shootouts-in-northern-mexican-town-kill-21-fueling-debate-on-cartels-idUSKBN1Y515O (Reuters)]
*[[2019 attacks on Burkina Faso]]
**Gunmen [[mass shooting|open fire]] on a church in [[Burkina Faso]] killing fourteen Christians and wounding dozens of others. The attack took place in a village in [[Foutouri (department)|Foutouri]], [[Est Region (Burkina Faso)|Est Region]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-burkina-security/at-least-14-killed-in-attack-on-burkina-faso-church-idUSKBN1Y51C6 (Reuters)]
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**A [[Camair-Co]] plane is fired upon while attempting to land at [[Bamenda Airport]], but the pilot manages to safely land the plane with no casualties reported. [https://www.rt.com/newsline/474792-passenger-plane-attacked-cameroon/ (RT)]
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**[[Rami Abdul Rahman]] says clashes in [[Idlib]] between [[Islamist]]s and the [[Syrian Arab Army]] kill around 70. Around 36 [[Syria|Syrian]] soldiers were killed in the two day clash. [https://www.france24.com/en/20191201-clashes-syrian-government-forces-militant-groups-leave-nearly-70-dead-idlib-jihadists-opposition (France 24)]

;Disasters and accidents
*Nineteen people die when a bus skids off a bridge in [[Zabaykalsky Krai]] in the [[Russian Far East]], and falls onto a frozen river. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-russia-accident-bus/nineteen-people-killed-in-bus-crash-in-russias-far-east-local-government-idUSKBN1Y50V8 (Reuters)]
*Twenty-four people are killed and 18 injured when a bus plunges into a [[ravine]] in [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/12/bus-crash-northern-tunisia-kills-20-191201142400774.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Three people are killed in a plane crash in [[San Antonio]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/12/01/us/san-antonio-plane-crash/index.html (CNN)]

**Three children in one family are among those killed by the outbreak. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/nov/30/there-are-no-words-samoa-buries-its-children-as-measles-outbreak-worsens (''The Guardian'')]
*[[World AIDS Day]]

[https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/health-and-families/world-aids-day-theme-when-is-it-what-hiv-status-health-awareness-campaign-a8652271.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/11/29/health/AIDS-drugs-children.html (''The New York Times'')] {{wikispore-event|Event:World AIDS Day 2019}}
